decisions.reason: The IMU module reuses the platform's firmware, bindings and in-house production, so holding it costs little, and no evidence yet shows it lacks value.
The industrial AC voltage input module has its own page and supports the push into industrial automation and energy, so the option is worth keeping open cheaply.
The solid state relay module extends the established relay range at minimal carrying cost, and its uncertainty has not resolved against it.
The RGB LED control module is newly launched and cheap to keep within the modular system, so it is too early to abandon it.
The wallbox remote access service supports the strategic expansion into charging and energy management and may become a platform for further services, so it is worth keeping.
